Dear 6thman.digital team,

I'm applying for the UI/UX Designer & Shopify Developer role. Your job description reads like my ideal mix: design that carries the price, code that makes it real, and CRO that keeps it honest.

At Episto, I build and maintain client sites in WordPress, run on-page SEO, and write content that converts. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, close to Ghent, and I'd love to show you what I've built.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear 6thman.digital team,

I'm applying for the UI/UX Designer & Shopify Developer role. Your description of a designer who understands the browser and a developer with taste is exactly the kind of hybrid I'm building toward. I don't have three years of agency experience yet, but I have a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and front-end development, and I'm hungry to grow into the full stack you describe.

At Episto, I build and maintain client websites in WordPress, run on-page SEO, and write keyword-targeted content. That work taught me how design decisions affect search visibility and conversion. On mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page site from scratch, implemented structured data (JSON-LD, SportsEvent, FAQPage), and ran iterative technical audits that measurably improved search health. I also have front-end experience from ViviDoctor, where I developed features in AngularJS and JavaScript.

I haven't shipped a Shopify store yet, but I'm actively learning Liquid and Next.js. I understand the importance of a design system that holds up at scale, and I'm comfortable with Figma, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JSON. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, close to Ghent, and I'm ready to work hard to get up to speed fast.

I'd love to show you what I've built and discuss how I can contribute to your team. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
